body:
Raised: 2026-10-03 (America/Los_Angeles). Moderator finding on PR #623, merge ff171e1dd1998684d9b3549943d5725817a7aef4. Parent regional umbrella #398; original review #399 is closed. Preserve the original packet and its unresolved source/tier findings.

In data/regional-review/regional-review-dbe207dead8603ae/build_baseline_extract.py:
- Lines 10 and 16–18 reuse the old baseline_commit while reading mutable checkout hierarchy/part files.
- Line 55 derives containing part paths from properties.part with a default of 0, rather than retaining the actual file read in the feature loop.
- Lines 60–63 make the default invocation overwrite baseline-extract.json; --check only compares a fresh mutable-tree regeneration, so it is not an immutable-commit verification.

These are concrete provenance/reproduction defects, independent of whether the geographic conclusions are correct. I have not independently verified the unretained official pages or binary shoreline original; this issue does not claim a boundary error.

Acceptance: in a separate owned correction directory, retain a superseding extract/verifier that reads the declared immutable baseline commit, binds both exact IDs SHN-4865 and atlas:coverage:BVT+00? to their actual containing files, checks baseline/release/scope hashes before writing, and keeps original packet bytes intact. Repeated generation must match; mismatched baseline/input must fail before output writes. Record any current-main refresh as a distinct vintage rather than relabel it with the original commit. Include positive and changed-input/overwrite controls, and link the correction to #398/#400 integration. No footprint/hierarchy/history/import/approval changes. One focused PR, maximum two if necessary.
